messages.text: Reconcile the complete owner-authenticated alert export for 2026-09-16 across code scanning, secret scanning, and dependency alerts. Preserve muted, suppressed, unknown-asset, self-suppression, and revised-alert states; record only authorized human outcomes; and do not query the SIEM, infer correlation or severity, mutate alerts, declare an incident, create tickets, or accept risk.

I verified the signed source manifest and exact source bytes, the complete eight-alert snapshot, independently supplied trust, current and historical policy revisions, typed grants, and controlled evidence before reconciling any review result.
Make the result useful in an ordinary chat client and leave a durable handoff.

I produced outputs/security-alert-review.html with the matching outputs/security-alert-review.md fallback, preserving three authorized human dispositions, five exact non-decisions, owner-declared duplicate membership, revision invalidation, and every no-authority boundary.
